topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I wander through the quiet of the place I call mine, the air heavy with secrets I cannot speak. Shadows play on the walls where once only light and color danced, unmarred. Now, there are marks, intrusions by hands not my own, altering the faces I labored over in solitude. They speak not of me but of someone else's story, layered now atop my silent whispers. The world feels smaller, the air less sweet. I move slower, each step a reminder of the altered silences. I find myself reaching out, tracing the lines I know by heart, trying to remember the untouched versions, wishing for a blank canvas once more.
